Li Hua plans to celebrate the Chinese Lunar New Year by hosting a festive gathering at her place on January 18th. The celebration will involve enjoying good food and company, which includes preparing traditional dishes such as dumplings and rice cakes. Li Hua also intends to set up decorations to create a festive atmosphere. Her plans are centered around enjoying traditional food and possibly traveling to experience local festivities. The anticipation of the event is shared with WolfgangSchulz, who is interested in participating and visiting Li Hua's celebration, particularly looking forward to the dumplings and inquiring about any additional drinks that might be part of the celebration.

In summary, Li Hua's celebration of the Chinese Lunar New Year is expected to be a cultural and culinary experience focused on traditional dishes, with an opportunity for social interaction and sharing of experiences with friends and WolfgangSchulz. Li Hua seems to be enthusiastic about fostering a lively and traditional environment, ensuring the celebration will reflect the cultural significance of the event.
